## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

WatchHistoryStore — core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sync/WatchHistoryStore.kt

## Trigger

ProfileSyncPushService.applyIncoming, calling watchHistoryStore.replaceAll(payload.history) — observed

## Today

WatchHistoryStore is an interface only, declaring replaceAll(entries) and
observe(): Flow<List<RaceHistoryEntry>>. No implementation exists in
core-data or anywhere else in the codebase — a grep for "WatchHistory" in
core-data returns nothing. ProfileSyncPushService.applyIncoming already
calls watchHistoryStore.replaceAll(payload.history) on the watch side, and
WatchHistoryViewModel already collects watchHistoryStore.observe(), so both
the writer and the reader depend on an implementation that is never
provided.

## Expected

A Room-backed implementation of WatchHistoryStore lives in :core-data,
following the RaceRepositoryImpl / ProfileRepositoryImpl pattern: it
persists the entries passed to replaceAll as a whole block, replacing any
previously stored set, and re-emits the stored list on every replaceAll
call through observe(), so the watch history survives process death.
